subject: Copywriting
title: Sustainability as Luxury Language
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Sustainability as Luxury Language.

hook.text: Stella McCartney's copy reads: 'No leather, no fur, no compromise.' Sustainability became luxury's new language.

buildup.text: LVMH, Kering, and Richemont now include sustainability metrics in their annual reports.

discovery.text: Luxury and sustainability are natural partners: buy less, buy better.

twist.text: But luxury brands also destroy unsold inventory to protect exclusivity.

climax.text: Sustainability language in luxury is powerful when authentic and devastating when exposed as greenwashing.

punchline.text: Buy less, buy better. Sustainability is luxury's newest language—if real.

quiz.question: Why are luxury and sustainability natural partners?
options: Buy less, buy better aligns with anti-fast-fashion
